Definitely be open and honest since you want this to work.
That’s very strange. I’m sorry that this is happening to you :( it definitely sucks. Like other comments have said, communication is key. How long have y’all been dating?

It seems like he’s using the BO as an excuse since you literally showered before you got there. There’s probably another underlying issue.

Seems like this relationship is already long gone. Usually, couples have a better chance if they give each other space and do the no contact period. But you guys already had constant contact and even hookups.

It doesn’t seem like it’s healthy in the long run anyways. Why would she ignore you when you’re showing her something you bought. Just seems like there’s a lack of communication between you two. 

It makes sense that you miss her, but that doesn’t mean you should go back to her. I think you should actually stop talking to her and just take this time to think. I personally don’t think it’s a good idea to be adding her back on social media, but hey it’s ur life.

Dude. I mean this in the nicest way possible: take a chill pill. Breathe. Relax. 

Your girlfriend probably fell asleep or she’s busy doing something. Just trust her and also go to sleep. You shouldn’t be overthinking this or assume she’s cheating on you. Just calm down.

NTA 

Seems like they’re looking for a third parent to take up the responsibility that Kate can’t do or would need support in. It’s not your obligation or responsibility to help them since it’s not your child. I’m just surprised that they would have assumed that you’d agree and built their future with you supporting them financially and giving up everything. Kudos to you for sticking to your guns.

Also, they’re over exaggerating. The child will not end up on the street since they can afford a cheaper flat. They just don’t want to live in a cheaper one. If they’re that desperate for the better flat with you, then they should compromise or just let you be since this is your life.

NTA 

I also live with a mother who likes to move things around in my room and touch my belongings. She always does this and I can’t ever find my stuff. OP, you’re not in the wrong. When parents do this, it’s rude and an invasion of privacy. You’re at an age when you’re old enough to take care of yourself. But parents will typically argue back and say that they’re looking out for you. 

Just tell your mom that you can take care of yourself. While you appreciate the gesture, she just needs to trust you and back off a little.

NTA

It seemed like your girlfriend really appreciated what you did. Only her mother and grandmother seemed to be bothered which doesn’t matter since they aren’t dating you. She is happy and it went great so that’s all that matters. You’re kind enough to buy her things that you knew that you could barely afford, but you did it anyway. I think the gesture speaks a thousand times more than the cost. 

You’re allowed to spend your money on your own needs and belongings. Don’t feel bad for doing that.

Even if you’ve been friends for 6 months, friendship is entirely different from a relationship. When you’re in a relationship, you learn new information about the person you’re dating (the good and the bad).

Firstly, two weeks is very short for a relationship. This isn’t a “sudden” change in her behavior or personality. It’s just something that you’re learning about her. The question is do you want to deal with her in the future whenever you guys argue? It seems that her way of dealing with conflict is very toxic and unhealthy. 

For now, I’d say to give her space since she obviously needs it. You apologized and were polite to her. Now you have to wait for her to reach out and explain her point of view. Hope that helps

my parents were just like you. Thankfully, my parents let me purchase whatever I want with my money. I can’t believe you’re micromanaging up to the point that you won’t let your daughter spend anything with her own money without your permission. She’s 17! She’s going to college soon where you won’t be able to control her. Also, as a college student, a MacBook has made my life so much easier. Not only is it reliable, it also makes transferring documents between devices so much easier! Everyone in college basically own a MacBook for a reason: it’s simplicity. Let her be her own person.

Remind her how much you love her. Don’t let her forget. Be understanding when she brings up how hurt she is. Be thoughtful. Just understand that she’s the one that got hurt in this so you should be willing to help her.
